description:
### Release v3.16.2

- **Fix AI Writing Tools on 18.5.4**: Safeguarded 18.0.3-specific GenAI/NGA bytecode retry predicates so they safely no-op on Gboard 18.5.4 instead of raising PatchException.
- **Dual 18.0.3 & 18.5.4 Compatibility**: Full patch support for 25 core patches on both 18.0.3 and 18.5.4.
